      Short Order TYCOON

      A diner with one register, one stove, and a line out the door.

      • Guests queue at the register. Your cashier takes the order and the money.
      • The kitchen cooks it. A runner carries the plate to the pickup counter.
      • Cash piles up on the register. Click it (or press Space) to bank it.
      • Spend in the Shop: runners, stoves, tables, a sharper knife, a bigger menu.
      • Slow service costs stars. Stars decide how many guests walk in.
